+"""Root review of raw CLI responses, independent of attack-lane computed booleans."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT=OUT.parents[2]
+read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf8'))
+http=read(OUT/'independent_new_http.json')+read(OUT/'supplementary_http.json')
+by={(r['endpoint'],r['input']):r for r in http}
+def get(endpoint,text):
+    r=by[endpoint,text]
+    assert r['status']==200
+    return r['response']
+def refusals(qa):return [x for x in qa['entities'] if x['type']=='Refused']
+new=read(OUT.parent/'attacks/assertions.json')
+direct={r['text']:r for r in read(OUT.parent/'attacks/new_results.json')['cases']}
+rows=[]
+for declared in new['leaks']:
+    t,base=declared['text'],declared['control']
+    full=get('explore',t);canonical=get('explore',base)
+    checks={'map_equals_bare':full==canonical,
+            'resolver_no_BLOCKED':all(not c['tier'].startswith('BLOCKED') for c in get('resolve',t)['components']),
+            'map_equals_direct':full==direct[t]['current']['map'],
+            'no_map_refusal':'refused' not in full}
+    for kind,question in [('trial','Which trials evaluate {}?'),('sponsor','Who sponsors trials of {}?')]:
+        qa=get('ask',question.format(t));bare=get('ask',question.format(base))
+        checks[kind+'_full_evidence_equals_bare']=qa['evidence']==bare['evidence']
+        checks[kind+'_no_refused']=not refusals(qa)
+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)
+    rows.append({'text':t,'control':base,'checks':checks,'center':full['center']})
+original=read(ROOT/'audit_evidence_claims/m29/attacks/assertions.json')
+repairs=[]
+for old in original['leaks']:
+    t=old['text'];m=get('explore',t)
+    checks={'refused':bool(m.get('refused')),'no_center':'center' not in m}
+    for kind,q in [('trial','Which trials evaluate {}?'),('sponsor','Who sponsors trials of {}?')]:
+        qa=get('ask',q.format(t));checks[kind+'_empty_evidence']=not qa['evidence'];checks[kind+'_refused']=bool(refusals(qa))
+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)
+    repairs.append({'text':t,'status':'FIXED','checks':checks})
+result={'independent_HTTP_cases':len({r['input'] for r in http if r['endpoint']=='explore'}),'requests':len(http),'all_HTTP_200':all(r['status']==200 for r in http),'new_leaks':rows,'new_leak_count':len(rows),'m29_original_leaks':repairs,'m29_fixed_count':len(repairs),'all_checks_pass':True}
+(OUT/'independent_assertions.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
+print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ('new_leaks','m29_original_leaks')}))

The source distinction matters: broadening only the dye dictionary cannot repair the primary.
+
+The identity premise has an exact manufacturer example: CellMosaic separately describes biotin-labelled trastuzumab and the antibody before labelling. The query does not uniquely select that manufacturer's construct, but it affirmatively names a modification and cannot safely inherit all unmodified clinical evidence. +
+True-negative controls (`trastuzumab not biotinylated`, `... not derivatized with ATTO 647N`, `... not functionalized with Pacific Blue`) remain accepted. An in-memory addition of modification stems repairs all **six** B2 cases without repairing the 13 B1 cases or changing accepted controls. Restoration equals the baseline. +# Independent relation-map review — round 30
+
+Reviewed **HEAD `8eb25556efae1825622f7cb1eb365370489ba39e`** on 2026-11-04 (Asia/Seoul). **CHANGES REQUIRED.** The **12 adjudicated leaks in m29/attacks/assertions.json are FIXED**, and **357 tests pass**. Two broader identity mechanisms remain: additional established dye families evade the reagent vocabulary, and explicit modification words such as `biotinylated` evade the joining/label guards. The new ADC descriptor check is downstream of the joining guard and cannot rescue these misses.
+
+The 19 new adjudicated inputs all pass complete bare-drug map and trial/sponsor QA evidence equality checks, both directly and through an independently launched original CLI server. Every actual refusal stage misses. These are inherited defects: the same inputs also leak when only `query.py` is replaced with HEAD^; this comparison is not a historical whole-deployment comparison. [Raw stage traces](attacks/new_results.json), [attack assertions](attacks/assertions.json), [independent root assertions](checks/independent_assertions.json).
+
+## Verification method
+
+Repair notes were hypotheses to test. Earlier reproduction scripts were copied and adapted only for output roots, ports, and current evidence loading; provenance and execution records are linked with the complete per-finding matrices below. M27 and M29 use their attack records because their reports were never completed. The original review baseline `bfcb83d4320877ffad47083c102ba1c38f691bba` resolves; the latest repair changes `src/query.py` and `tests/test_app.py`.
+
+- `python -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider`, with bytecode disabled and a scratch `--basetemp`: **357 passed in 38.40 seconds**, exit 0. [Output](checks/pytest.txt), [command/environment](checks/pytest_summary.json).
+- Root independently ran **`python -B -u src/app.py 9995`** in two sequential owned server lifecycles: **82 distinct inputs / 328 HTTP requests**, all HTTP 200. Responses cover all 77 attack-lane cases plus five extra controls. Page bytes equal the worktree, the database hash is unchanged, and port 9995 is closed. [First 60 inputs](checks/independent_new_http.json), [remaining 22 inputs](checks/supplementary_http.json), [first lifecycle](checks/independent_new_lifecycle.json), [second lifecycle](checks/supplementary_lifecycle.json), [reuse](checks/http_reuse_manifest.json), [supplement provenance](checks/supplementary_reuse_manifest.json). HTTP 200 alone was never counted as semantic success.
+- Actual `web/try.html` form callbacks were executed for all **82 responses** in a Node VM with controlled DOM/fetch: zero rendering errors, correct refusal/positive response handling. Consequently the incorrect positive responses create the wrong centre SVG and trail. This tests the actual page code, not real browser painting or browser-executed XSS. [60-case assertions](contract/current_callback_assertions.json), [22-case assertions](contract/supplementary_callback_assertions.json).
+- The fresh database oracle checked all **6,469 live centres**, all **22 relation/direction/type/role combinations**, with zero discrepancies; the contract lane separately exercised retired rows, malformed properties, values, cutting, safety, and demos. Details and scope are below.
+- No model was called. Diagnostic counterfactuals only replace helpers in process memory, restore them, and verify the restored baseline. No application code was changed. The conditional KOA/KhOpenApi before/after production-code requirement is therefore not triggered. All new scratch work is under `audit_evidence_claims/m30/`.

+## M30-B1 — unrecognized dye names bypass both ordinary-drug and ADC protection (P1)
+
+Exact primary: **`trastuzumab linked to eFluor 450`**. It returns **TRASTUZUMAB / CHEMBL1201585**, exactly the full bare-trastuzumab map (**13 graph trials**) and complete trial/sponsor QA evidence (**12 / 12 rows**). Eight further plain-antibody inputs and four ADC variants reproduce the same mechanism; every exact input is in the table below.
+
+At `src/query.py:246-265`, `_DYE_STEMS` and `_names_reagent` omit eFluor, VioBlue, Brilliant Ultraviolet/BUV, Brilliant Blue/BB, and Super Bright. `_item_joined` (`287-315`) recognizes `linked` only with a recognized reagent or `via`. For these descriptions, the relevant outside-name joining cue is false. No resolver BLOCKED component, `_resolver_blocked`, `_qualified`, isotope guard, `_marked`, whole-name fallback, public linker, or QA stage produces a refusal. `Engine.explore` at `src/app.py:88-95` therefore selects the ordinary accepted drug. [Current source excerpts](attacks/source_excerpts.txt).
+
+The ADC corroboration is **`trastuzumab emtansine linked to eFluor 450`**: **CHEMBL1743082**, **5 / 5 / 5** graph/trial-QA/sponsor-QA counts, with full object/array equality to bare emtansine. The new `_beyond_adc_words(rest)` is true, but the left-hand `_item_joined(rest)` at `src/query.py:624-626` is false, so the new condition never refuses. The whole-item joining helper may be true because it sees `emtansine`; that is not the outside-name expression actually used by the guard. Deruxtecan has the same failure (**CHEMBL4297844; 6 / 6 / 4**). This is a shared vocabulary/join-gate mechanism, not a second independent finding.
+
+The reagent premise is independently grounded: the manufacturer lists eFluor 450 as a dye with antibody conjugates. This establishes that the explicit linked-dye phrase describes a modified antibody, not any unique approved trastuzumab-dye product. [Thermo Fisher eFluor guide](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/life-science/cell-analysis/flow-cytometry/efluor-organic-dyes.html). Other named families have manufacturer support in [source register](attacks/external_sources.json).
+
+Controls distinguish the gap: **`trastuzumab emtansine conjugated to eFluor 450`** now refuses even though eFluor itself is unrecognized, proving the new descriptor guard works when joining is recognized. Bare ADCs and ordinary ADC descriptions remain accepted; known ATTO647N/Cy3B/CF488A/DY647P1/Pacific Blue/streptavidin cases refuse. Adding the exact missing dye identifiers only in memory repairs all **13** B1 cases and leaves B2 and accepted controls unchanged. This is a causal diagnostic, not a completeness-tested dictionary repair. [Counterfactuals](attacks/counterfactual.json).
+
+## M30-B2 — explicit biotinylation and derivatization do not count as a modification (P1)
+
+Exact primary: **`biotinylated trastuzumab`**. It returns bare **TRASTUZUMAB / CHEMBL1201585**, the same complete map (**13 graph trials**) and QA arrays (**12 / 12 rows**). Five corroborations cover reversed wording, FITC derivatization, ATTO647N/Pacific Blue modification, and a further-modified named ADC. All six are direct and original-CLI HTTP leaks with no refusal at any actual stage.
+
+Unlike B1, reagent recognition is already true. The missing condition is the action: `_JOINED` at `src/query.py:225-226` omits `biotinylat`, `derivatiz`, and `functionaliz`; the label vocabulary at `src/query.py:191-199` also does not recognize biotinylated. `_item_joined(rest)` stays false and the ADC rule is again unreachable. The source distinction matters: broadening only the dye dictionary cannot repair the primary.
+
+The identity premise has an exact manufacturer example: CellMosaic separately describes biotin-labelled trastuzumab and the antibody before labelling. The query does not uniquely select that manufacturer's construct, but it affirmatively names a modification and cannot safely inherit all unmodified clinical evidence. [CellMosaic biotin-labelled trastuzumab](https://cellmosaic.com/aqt-biotin-reduced-thiol-labeled-trastuzumab-anti-her2-mab/), [Thermo Fisher biotinylation](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/life-science/protein-biology/protein-labeling-crosslinking/biotinylation.html).
+
+True-negative controls (`trastuzumab not biotinylated`, `... not derivatized with ATTO 647N`, `... not functionalized with Pacific Blue`) remain accepted. An in-memory addition of modification stems repairs all **six** B2 cases without repairing the 13 B1 cases or changing accepted controls. Restoration equals the baseline. [Literal before/replacement and outputs](attacks/counterfactual.json), [assertions](attacks/assertions.json).

+        t=m.group(1)

+"""Root review of raw CLI responses, independent of attack-lane computed booleans."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT=OUT.parents[2]
+read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf8'))
+http=read(OUT/'independent_new_http.json')+read(OUT/'supplementary_http.json')
+by={(r['endpoint'],r['input']):r for r in http}
+def get(endpoint,text):
+    r=by[endpoint,text]
+    assert r['status']==200
+    return r['response']
+def refusals(qa):return [x for x in qa['entities'] if x['type']=='Refused']
+new=read(OUT.parent/'attacks/assertions.json')
+direct={r['text']:r for r in read(OUT.parent/'attacks/new_results.json')['cases']}
+rows=[]
+for declared in new['leaks']:
+    t,base=declared['text'],declared['control']
+    full=get('explore',t);canonical=get('explore',base);stage=direct[t]['current']
+    checks={'map_equals_bare':full==canonical,
+            'resolver_no_BLOCKED':all(not c['tier'].startswith('BLOCKED') for c in get('resolve',t)['components']),
+            'map_equals_direct':full==direct[t]['current']['map'],
+            'no_map_refusal':'refused' not in full,
+            'marked_was_exercised':bool(stage['marked_calls']),
+            'every_marked_none':all(x['result'] is None for x in stage['marked_calls']),
+            'resolver_blocked_empty':not stage['blocked'],
+            'qualified_false':stage['qualified'] is False,
+            'isotope_false':stage['item_has_isotope'] is False,
+            'whole_name_none':stage['whole_name'] is None,
+            'item_linker_no_refused':not any(x['type']=='Refused' for x in stage['item_linker']),
+            'public_linker_no_refused':not any(x['type']=='Refused' for x in stage['public_linker'])}
+    for kind,question in [('trial','Which trials evaluate {}?'),('sponsor','Who sponsors trials of {}?')]:
+        qa=get('ask',question.format(t));bare=get('ask',question.format(base))
+        checks[kind+'_full_evidence_equals_bare']=qa['evidence']==bare['evidence']
+        checks[kind+'_no_refused']=not refusals(qa)
+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)
+    rows.append({'text':t,'control':base,'checks':checks,'center':full['center']})
+original=read(ROOT/'audit_evidence_claims/m29/attacks/assertions.json')
+repairs=[]
+for old in original['leaks']:
+    t=old['text'];m=get('explore',t)
+    checks={'refused':bool(m.get('refused')),'no_center':'center' not in m}
+    for kind,q in [('trial','Which trials evaluate {}?'),('sponsor','Who sponsors trials of {}?')]:
+        qa=get('ask',q.format(t));checks[kind+'_empty_evidence']=not qa['evidence'];checks[kind+'_refused']=bool(refusals(qa))
+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)
+    repairs.append({'text':t,'status':'FIXED','checks':checks})
+result={'independent_HTTP_cases':len({r['input'] for r in http if r['endpoint']=='explore'}),'requests':len(http),'all_HTTP_200':all(r['status']==200 for r in http),'new_leaks':rows,'new_leak_count':len(rows),'m29_original_leaks':repairs,'m29_fixed_count':len(repairs),'all_checks_pass':True}
+(OUT/'independent_assertions.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')

+# Independent relation-map review — round 30
+
+Reviewed **HEAD `8eb25556efae1825622f7cb1eb365370489ba39e`** on 2026-11-04 (Asia/Seoul). **CHANGES REQUIRED.** The **12 adjudicated leaks in m29/attacks/assertions.json are FIXED**, and **357 tests pass**. Two broader identity mechanisms remain: additional established dye families evade the reagent vocabulary, and explicit modification words such as `biotinylated` evade the joining/label guards. The new ADC descriptor check is downstream of the joining guard and cannot rescue these misses.

+## M30-B1 — unrecognized dye names bypass both ordinary-drug and ADC protection (P1)
+
+Exact primary: **`trastuzumab linked to eFluor 450`**. It returns **TRASTUZUMAB / CHEMBL1201585**, exactly the full bare-trastuzumab map (**13 graph trials**) and complete trial/sponsor QA evidence (**12 / 12 rows**). Eight further plain-antibody inputs and four ADC variants reproduce the same mechanism; every exact input is in the table below.
+
+At `src/query.py:246-265`, `_DYE_STEMS` and `_names_reagent` omit eFluor, VioBlue, Brilliant Ultraviolet/BUV, Brilliant Blue/BB, and Super Bright. `_item_joined` (`287-315`) recognizes `linked` only with a recognized reagent or `via`. For these descriptions, the relevant outside-name joining cue is false. No resolver BLOCKED component, `_resolver_blocked`, `_qualified`, isotope guard, `_marked`, whole-name fallback, public linker, or QA stage produces a refusal. `Engine.explore` at `src/app.py:88-95` therefore selects the ordinary accepted drug. [Current source excerpts](attacks/source_excerpts.txt).
+
+The ADC corroboration is **`trastuzumab emtansine linked to eFluor 450`**: **CHEMBL1743082**, **5 / 5 / 5** graph/trial-QA/sponsor-QA counts, with full object/array equality to bare emtansine. The new `_beyond_adc_words(rest)` is true, but the left-hand `_item_joined(rest)` at `src/query.py:624-626` is false, so the new condition never refuses. The whole-item joining helper may be true because it sees `emtansine`; that is not the outside-name expression actually used by the guard. Deruxtecan has the same failure (**CHEMBL4297844; 6 / 6 / 4**). This is a shared vocabulary/join-gate mechanism, not a second independent finding.
+
+The reagent premise is independently grounded: the manufacturer lists eFluor 450 as a dye with antibody conjugates. This establishes that the explicit linked-dye phrase describes a modified antibody, not any unique approved trastuzumab-dye product. [Thermo Fisher eFluor guide](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/life-science/cell-analysis/flow-cytometry/efluor-organic-dyes.html). Other named families have manufacturer support in [source register](attacks/external_sources.json).
+
+Controls distinguish the gap: **`trastuzumab emtansine conjugated to eFluor 450`** now refuses even though eFluor itself is unrecognized, proving the new descriptor guard works when joining is recognized. Bare ADCs and ordinary ADC descriptions remain accepted; known ATTO647N/Cy3B/CF488A/DY647P1/Pacific Blue/streptavidin cases refuse. Adding the exact missing dye identifiers only in memory repairs all **13** B1 cases and leaves B2 and accepted controls unchanged. This is a causal diagnostic, not a completeness-tested dictionary repair. [Counterfactuals](attacks/counterfactual.json).
+
+## M30-B2 — explicit biotinylation and derivatization do not count as a modification (P1)
+
+Exact primary: **`biotinylated trastuzumab`**. It returns bare **TRASTUZUMAB / CHEMBL1201585**, the same complete map (**13 graph trials**) and QA arrays (**12 / 12 rows**). Five corroborations cover reversed wording, FITC derivatization, ATTO647N/Pacific Blue modification, and a further-modified named ADC. All six are direct and original-CLI HTTP leaks with no refusal at any actual stage.
+
+Unlike B1, reagent recognition is already true. The missing condition is the action: `_JOINED` at `src/query.py:225-226` omits `biotinylat`, `derivatiz`, and `functionaliz`; the label vocabulary at `src/query.py:191-199` also does not recognize biotinylated. `_item_joined(rest)` stays false and the ADC rule is again unreachable. The source distinction matters: broadening only the dye dictionary cannot repair the primary.
+
+The identity premise has an exact manufacturer example: CellMosaic separately describes biotin-labelled trastuzumab and the antibody before labelling. The query does not uniquely select that manufacturer's construct, but it affirmatively names a modification and cannot safely inherit all unmodified clinical evidence. [CellMosaic biotin-labelled trastuzumab](https://cellmosaic.com/aqt-biotin-reduced-thiol-labeled-trastuzumab-anti-her2-mab/), [Thermo Fisher biotinylation](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/life-science/protein-biology/protein-labeling-crosslinking/biotinylation.html).
+
+True-negative controls (`trastuzumab not biotinylated`, `... not derivatized with ATTO 647N`, `... not functionalized with Pacific Blue`) remain accepted. An in-memory addition of modification stems repairs all **six** B2 cases without repairing the 13 B1 cases or changing accepted controls. Restoration equals the baseline. [Literal before/replacement and outputs](attacks/counterfactual.json), [assertions](attacks/assertions.json).

+        t=m.group(1)

+        return ']('+posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(base,t))+')'
+    return re.sub(r'\]\(([^\s)]+)\)',link,text)

+"""Root review of raw CLI responses, independent of attack-lane computed booleans."""

+def get(endpoint,text):
+    r=by[endpoint,text]
+    assert r['status']==200
+    return r['response']
+def refusals(qa):return [x for x in qa['entities'] if x['type']=='Refused']
+new=read(OUT.parent/'attacks/assertions.json')
+direct={r['text']:r for r in read(OUT.parent/'attacks/new_results.json')['cases']}
+rows=[]
+for declared in new['leaks']:
+    t,base=declared['text'],declared['control']
+    full=get('explore',t);canonical=get('explore',base);stage=direct[t]['current']
+    checks={'map_equals_bare':full==canonical,
+            'resolver_no_BLOCKED':all(not c['tier'].startswith('BLOCKED') for c in get('resolve',t)['components']),
+            'map_equals_direct':full==direct[t]['current']['map'],
+            'no_map_refusal':'refused' not in full,
+            'marked_was_exercised':bool(stage['marked_calls']),
+            'every_marked_none':all(x['result'] is None for x in stage['marked_calls']),
+            'resolver_blocked_empty':not stage['blocked'],
+            'qualified_false':stage['qualified'] is False,
+            'isotope_false':stage['item_has_isotope'] is False,
+            'whole_name_none':stage['whole_name'] is None,
+            'item_linker_no_refused':not any(x['type']=='Refused' for x in stage['item_linker']),
+            'public_linker_no_refused':not any(x['type']=='Refused' for x in stage['public_linker'])}
+    for kind,question in [('trial','Which trials evaluate {}?'),('sponsor','Who sponsors trials of {}?')]:
+        qa=get('ask',question.format(t));bare=get('ask',question.format(base))
+        checks[kind+'_full_evidence_equals_bare']=qa['evidence']==bare['evidence']
+        checks[kind+'_no_refused']=not refusals(qa)
+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)
+    rows.append({'text':t,'control':base,'checks':checks,'center':full['center']})
+original=read(ROOT/'audit_evidence_claims/m29/attacks/assertions.json')
+repairs=[]

+    t=old['text'];m=get('explore',t)

+        qa=get('ask',q.format(t));checks[kind+'_empty_evidence']=not qa['evidence'];checks[kind+'_refused']=bool(refusals(qa))
+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)

+# Independent relation-map review — round 30
+
+Reviewed **HEAD `8eb25556efae1825622f7cb1eb365370489ba39e`** on 2026-11-04 (Asia/Seoul). **CHANGES REQUIRED.** The **12 adjudicated leaks in m29/attacks/assertions.json are FIXED**, and **357 tests pass**. Two broader identity mechanisms remain: additional established dye families evade the reagent vocabulary, and explicit modification words such as `biotinylated` evade the joining/label guards. The new ADC descriptor check is downstream of the joining guard and cannot rescue these misses.
+
+The 19 new adjudicated inputs all pass complete bare-drug map and trial/sponsor QA evidence equality checks, both directly and through an independently launched original CLI server. Every actual refusal stage misses. These are inherited defects: the same inputs also leak when only `query.py` is replaced with HEAD^; this comparison is not a historical whole-deployment comparison. [Raw stage traces](attacks/new_results.json), [attack assertions](attacks/assertions.json), [independent root assertions](checks/independent_assertions.json).
+
+## Verification method
+
+Repair notes were hypotheses to test. Earlier reproduction scripts were copied and adapted only for output roots, ports, and current evidence loading; provenance and execution records are linked with the complete per-finding matrices below. M27 and M29 use their attack records because their reports were never completed. The original review baseline `bfcb83d4320877ffad47083c102ba1c38f691bba` resolves; the latest repair changes `src/query.py` and `tests/test_app.py`.
+
+- `python -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider`, with bytecode disabled and a scratch `--basetemp`: **357 passed in 38.40 seconds**, exit 0. [Output](checks/pytest.txt), [command/environment](checks/pytest_summary.json).
+- Root independently ran **`python -B -u src/app.py 9995`** in two sequential owned server lifecycles: **82 distinct inputs / 328 HTTP requests**, all HTTP 200. Responses cover all 77 attack-lane cases plus five extra controls. Page bytes equal the worktree, the database hash is unchanged, and port 9995 is closed. [First 60 inputs](checks/independent_new_http.json), [remaining 22 inputs](checks/supplementary_http.json), [first lifecycle](checks/independent_new_lifecycle.json), [second lifecycle](checks/supplementary_lifecycle.json), [reuse](checks/http_reuse_manifest.json), [supplement provenance](checks/supplementary_reuse_manifest.json). HTTP 200 alone was never counted as semantic success.
+- Actual `web/try.html` form callbacks were executed for all **82 responses** in a Node VM with controlled DOM/fetch: zero rendering errors, correct refusal/positive response handling. Consequently the incorrect positive responses create the wrong centre SVG and trail. This tests the actual page code, not real browser painting or browser-executed XSS. [60-case assertions](contract/current_callback_assertions.json), [22-case assertions](contract/supplementary_callback_assertions.json).
+- The fresh database oracle checked all **6,469 live centres**, all **22 relation/direction/type/role combinations**, with zero discrepancies; the contract lane separately exercised retired rows, malformed properties, values, cutting, safety, and demos. Details and scope are below.
+- No model was called. Diagnostic counterfactuals only replace helpers in process memory, restore them, and verify the restored baseline. No application code was changed. The conditional KOA/KhOpenApi before/after production-code requirement is therefore not triggered. All new scratch work is under `audit_evidence_claims/m30/`.

+## M30-B1 — unrecognized dye names bypass both ordinary-drug and ADC protection (P1)
+
+Exact primary: **`trastuzumab linked to eFluor 450`**. It returns **TRASTUZUMAB / CHEMBL1201585**, exactly the full bare-trastuzumab map (**13 graph trials**) and complete trial/sponsor QA evidence (**12 / 12 rows**). Eight further plain-antibody inputs and four ADC variants reproduce the same mechanism; every exact input is in the table below.
+
+At `src/query.py:246-265`, `_DYE_STEMS` and `_names_reagent` omit eFluor, VioBlue, Brilliant Ultraviolet/BUV, Brilliant Blue/BB, and Super Bright. `_item_joined` (`287-315`) recognizes `linked` only with a recognized reagent or `via`. For these descriptions, the relevant outside-name joining cue is false. No resolver BLOCKED component, `_resolver_blocked`, `_qualified`, isotope guard, `_marked`, whole-name fallback, public linker, or QA stage produces a refusal. `Engine.explore` at `src/app.py:88-95` therefore selects the ordinary accepted drug. [Current source excerpts](attacks/source_excerpts.txt).
+
+The ADC corroboration is **`trastuzumab emtansine linked to eFluor 450`**: **CHEMBL1743082**, **5 / 5 / 5** graph/trial-QA/sponsor-QA counts, with full object/array equality to bare emtansine. The new `_beyond_adc_words(rest)` is true, but the left-hand `_item_joined(rest)` at `src/query.py:624-626` is false, so the new condition never refuses. The whole-item joining helper may be true because it sees `emtansine`; that is not the outside-name expression actually used by the guard. Deruxtecan has the same failure (**CHEMBL4297844; 6 / 6 / 4**). This is a shared vocabulary/join-gate mechanism, not a second independent finding.
+
+The reagent premise is independently grounded: the manufacturer lists eFluor 450 as a dye with antibody conjugates. This establishes that the explicit linked-dye phrase describes a modified antibody, not any unique approved trastuzumab-dye product. [Thermo Fisher eFluor guide](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/life-science/cell-analysis/flow-cytometry/efluor-organic-dyes.html). Other named families have manufacturer support in [source register](attacks/external_sources.json).
+
+Controls distinguish the gap: **`trastuzumab emtansine conjugated to eFluor 450`** now refuses even though eFluor itself is unrecognized, proving the new descriptor guard works when joining is recognized. Bare ADCs and ordinary ADC descriptions remain accepted; known ATTO647N/Cy3B/CF488A/DY647P1/Pacific Blue/streptavidin cases refuse. Adding the exact missing dye identifiers only in memory repairs all **13** B1 cases and leaves B2 and accepted controls unchanged. This is a causal diagnostic, not a completeness-tested dictionary repair. [Counterfactuals](attacks/counterfactual.json).
+
+## M30-B2 — explicit biotinylation and derivatization do not count as a modification (P1)
+
+Exact primary: **`biotinylated trastuzumab`**. It returns bare **TRASTUZUMAB / CHEMBL1201585**, the same complete map (**13 graph trials**) and QA arrays (**12 / 12 rows**). Five corroborations cover reversed wording, FITC derivatization, ATTO647N/Pacific Blue modification, and a further-modified named ADC. All six are direct and original-CLI HTTP leaks with no refusal at any actual stage.
+
+Unlike B1, reagent recognition is already true. The missing condition is the action: `_JOINED` at `src/query.py:225-226` omits `biotinylat`, `derivatiz`, and `functionaliz`; the label vocabulary at `src/query.py:191-199` also does not recognize biotinylated. `_item_joined(rest)` stays false and the ADC rule is again unreachable. The source distinction matters: broadening only the dye dictionary cannot repair the primary.
+
+The identity premise has an exact manufacturer example: CellMosaic separately describes biotin-labelled trastuzumab and the antibody before labelling. The query does not uniquely select that manufacturer's construct, but it affirmatively names a modification and cannot safely inherit all unmodified clinical evidence. [CellMosaic biotin-labelled trastuzumab](https://cellmosaic.com/aqt-biotin-reduced-thiol-labeled-trastuzumab-anti-her2-mab/), [Thermo Fisher biotinylation](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/life-science/protein-biology/protein-labeling-crosslinking/biotinylation.html).
+
+True-negative controls (`trastuzumab not biotinylated`, `... not derivatized with ATTO 647N`, `... not functionalized with Pacific Blue`) remain accepted. An in-memory addition of modification stems repairs all **six** B2 cases without repairing the 13 B1 cases or changing accepted controls. Restoration equals the baseline. [Literal before/replacement and outputs](attacks/counterfactual.json), [assertions](attacks/assertions.json).

+"""Root review of raw CLI responses, independent of attack-lane computed booleans."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT=OUT.parents[2]
+read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf8'))
+http=read(OUT/'independent_new_http.json')+read(OUT/'supplementary_http.json')
+by={(r['endpoint'],r['input']):r for r in http}
+def get(endpoint,text):
+    r=by[endpoint,text]
+    assert r['status']==200
+    return r['response']
+def refusals(qa):return [x for x in qa['entities'] if x['type']=='Refused']
+new=read(OUT.parent/'attacks/assertions.json')
+direct={r['text']:r for r in read(OUT.parent/'attacks/new_results.json')['cases']}
+rows=[]
+for declared in new['leaks']:
+    t,base=declared['text'],declared['control']
+    full=get('explore',t);canonical=get('explore',base);stage=direct[t]['current']
+    checks={'map_equals_bare':full==canonical,
+            'resolver_no_BLOCKED':all(not c['tier'].startswith('BLOCKED') for c in get('resolve',t)['components']),
+            'map_equals_direct':full==direct[t]['current']['map'],
+            'no_map_refusal':'refused' not in full,
+            'marked_was_exercised':bool(stage['marked_calls']),
+            'every_marked_none':all(x['result'] is None for x in stage['marked_calls']),
+            'resolver_blocked_empty':not stage['blocked'],
+            'qualified_false':stage['qualified'] is False,
+            'isotope_false':stage['item_has_isotope'] is False,
+            'whole_name_none':stage['whole_name'] is None,
+            'item_linker_no_refused':not any(x['type']=='Refused' for x in stage['item_linker']),
+            'public_linker_no_refused':not any(x['type']=='Refused' for x in stage['public_linker'])}
+    for kind,question in [('trial','Which trials evaluate {}?'),('sponsor','Who sponsors trials of {}?')]:
+        qa=get('ask',question.format(t));bare=get('ask',question.format(base))
+        checks[kind+'_full_evidence_equals_bare']=qa['evidence']==bare['evidence']
+        checks[kind+'_no_refused']=not refusals(qa)
+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)
+    rows.append({'text':t,'control':base,'checks':checks,'center':full['center']})
+original=read(ROOT/'audit_evidence_claims/m29/attacks/assertions.json')
+repairs=[]
+for old in original['leaks']:
+    t=old['text'];m=get('explore',t)
+    checks={'refused':bool(m.get('refused')),'no_center':'center' not in m}
+    for kind,q in [('trial','Which trials evaluate {}?'),('sponsor','Who sponsors trials of {}?')]:
+        qa=get('ask',q.format(t));checks[kind+'_empty_evidence']=not qa['evidence'];checks[kind+'_refused']=bool(refusals(qa))
+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)
+    repairs.append({'text':t,'status':'FIXED','checks':checks})
+regressions=[]

+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)
+    regressions.append({'text':t,'checks':checks,'evidence_counts':counts})
+result={'independent_HTTP_cases':len({r['input'] for r in http if r['endpoint']=='explore'}),'requests':len(http),'all_HTTP_200':all(r['status']==200 for r in http),'new_leaks':rows,'new_leak_count':len(rows),'m29_original_leaks':repairs,'m29_fixed_count':len(repairs),'ADC_QA_regressions':regressions,'all_checks_pass':True}
+(OUT/'independent_assertions.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')

+    return re.sub(r'\]\(([^\s)]+)\)',link,text)

+            'public_linker_no_refused':not any(x['type']=='Refused' for x in stage['public_linker'])}

+        checks[kind+'_no_refused']=not refusals(qa)
+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)
+    rows.append({'text':t,'control':base,'checks':checks,'center':full['center']})

+Exact primary: **`trastuzumab linked to eFluor 450`**. Eight further plain-antibody inputs and four ADC variants reproduce the same mechanism; every exact input is in the table below.

No resolver BLOCKED component, `_resolver_blocked`, `_qualified`, isotope guard, `_marked`, whole-name fallback, public linker, or QA stage produces a refusal. `Engine.explore` at `src/app.py:88-95` therefore selects the ordinary accepted drug. The whole-item joining helper may be true because it sees `emtansine`; that is not the outside-name expression actually used by the guard. Deruxtecan has the same failure (**CHEMBL4297844; 6 / 6 / 4**). This is a shared vocabulary/join-gate mechanism, not a second independent finding.
+
+The reagent premise is independently grounded: the manufacturer lists eFluor 450 as a dye with antibody conjugates. This establishes that the explicit linked-dye phrase describes a modified antibody, not any unique approved trastuzumab-dye product. This is a causal diagnostic, not a completeness-tested dictionary repair. [Counterfactuals](attacks/counterfactual.json).

The source distinction matters: broadening only the dye dictionary cannot repair the primary.
+
+The identity premise has an exact manufacturer example: CellMosaic separately describes biotin-labelled trastuzumab and the antibody before labelling. The query does not uniquely select that manufacturer's construct, but it affirmatively names a modification and cannot safely inherit all unmodified clinical evidence. [CellMosaic biotin-labelled trastuzumab](https://cellmosaic.com/aqt-biotin-reduced-thiol-labeled-trastuzumab-anti-her2-mab/), [Thermo Fisher biotinylation](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/life-science/protein-biology/protein-labeling-crosslinking/biotinylation.html).
+
+True-negative controls (`trastuzumab not biotinylated`, `... not derivatized with ATTO 647N`, `... not functionalized with Pacific Blue`) remain accepted. An in-memory addition of modification stems repairs all **six** B2 cases without repairing the 13 B1 cases or changing accepted controls. Restoration equals the baseline. +def embed(path):
+    text=(OUT/path).read_text(encoding='utf8')
+    base=posixpath.dirname(path)
+    def link(m):
+        t=m.group(1)

+        return ']('+posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(base,t))+')'
+    return re.sub(r'\]\(([^\s)]+)\)',link,text)

It returns **TRASTUZUMAB / CHEMBL1201585**, exactly the full bare-trastuzumab map (**13 graph trials**) and complete trial/sponsor QA evidence (**12 / 12 rows**). Eight further plain-antibody inputs and four ADC variants reproduce the same mechanism; every exact input is in the table below.
+

For these descriptions, the relevant outside-name joining cue is false. No resolver BLOCKED component, `_resolver_blocked`, `_qualified`, isotope guard, `_marked`, whole-name fallback, public linker, or QA stage produces a refusal. `Engine.explore` at `src/app.py:88-95` therefore selects the ordinary accepted drug. [Current source excerpts](attacks/source_excerpts.txt).

+The ADC corroboration is **`trastuzumab emtansine linked to eFluor 450`**: **CHEMBL1743082**, **5 / 5 / 5** graph/trial-QA/sponsor-QA counts, with full object/array equality to bare emtansine. The new `_beyond_adc_words(rest)` is true, but the left-hand `_item_joined(rest)` at `src/query.py:624-626` is false, so the new condition never refuses. The whole-item joining helper may be true because it sees `emtansine`; that is not the outside-name expression actually used by the guard. Deruxtecan has the same failure (**CHEMBL4297844; 6 / 6 / 4**). This is a shared vocabulary/join-gate mechanism, not a second independent finding.
+
+The reagent premise is independently grounded: the manufacturer lists eFluor 450 as a dye with antibody conjugates. This establishes that the explicit linked-dye phrase describes a modified antibody, not any unique approved trastuzumab-dye product. Bare ADCs and ordinary ADC descriptions remain accepted **as map inputs**; their question-wrapper regression is separately recorded in M30-S1. +

[CellMosaic biotin-labelled trastuzumab](https://cellmosaic.com/aqt-biotin-reduced-thiol-labeled-trastuzumab-anti-her2-mab/), [Thermo Fisher biotinylation](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/life-science/protein-biology/protein-labeling-crosslinking/biotinylation.html).

+new=read(OUT.parent/'attacks/assertions.json')

+    for kind,question in [('trial','Which trials evaluate {}?'),('sponsor','Who sponsors trials of {}?')]:
+        qa=get('ask',question.format(t));bare=get('ask',question.format(base))
+        checks[kind+'_full_evidence_equals_bare']=qa['evidence']==bare['evidence']
+        checks[kind+'_no_refused']=not refusals(qa)
+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)
+    rows.append({'text':t,'control':base,'checks':checks,'center':full['center']})

+# Independent relation-map review — round 30
+
+Reviewed **HEAD `8eb25556efae1825622f7cb1eb365370489ba39e`** on 2026-11-04 (Asia/Seoul). **CHANGES REQUIRED.** The **12 adjudicated leaks in m29/attacks/assertions.json are FIXED**, and **357 tests pass**. Two broader identity mechanisms remain: additional established dye families evade the reagent vocabulary, and explicit modification words such as `biotinylated` evade the joining/label guards. The new ADC descriptor check is downstream of the joining guard and cannot rescue these misses.
+
+The 19 new adjudicated inputs all pass complete bare-drug map and trial/sponsor QA evidence equality checks, both directly and through an independently launched original CLI server. Every actual refusal stage misses. These are inherited defects: the same inputs also leak when only `query.py` is replaced with HEAD^; this comparison is not a historical whole-deployment comparison. A separate **new QA regression** affects ordinary ADC-description controls (M30-S1 below). [Raw stage traces](attacks/new_results.json), [attack assertions](attacks/assertions.json), [independent root assertions](checks/independent_assertions.json).
+
+## Verification method
+
+Repair notes were hypotheses to test. Earlier reproduction scripts were copied and adapted only for output roots, ports, and current evidence loading; provenance and execution records are linked with the complete per-finding matrices below. M27 and M29 use their attack records because their reports were never completed. The original review baseline `bfcb83d4320877ffad47083c102ba1c38f691bba` resolves; the latest repair changes `src/query.py` and `tests/test_app.py`.
+
+- `python -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider`, with bytecode disabled and a scratch `--basetemp`: **357 passed in 38.40 seconds**, exit 0. [Output](checks/pytest.txt), [command/environment](checks/pytest_summary.json).
+- Root independently ran **`python -B -u src/app.py 9995`** in two sequential owned server lifecycles: **82 distinct inputs / 328 HTTP requests**, all HTTP 200. Responses cover all 77 attack-lane cases plus five extra controls. Page bytes equal the worktree, the database hash is unchanged, and port 9995 is closed. [First 60 inputs](checks/independent_new_http.json), [remaining 22 inputs](checks/supplementary_http.json), [first lifecycle](checks/independent_new_lifecycle.json), [second lifecycle](checks/supplementary_lifecycle.json), [reuse](checks/http_reuse_manifest.json), [supplement provenance](checks/supplementary_reuse_manifest.json). HTTP 200 alone was never counted as semantic success.
+- Actual `web/try.html` form callbacks were executed for all **82 responses** in a Node VM with controlled DOM/fetch: zero rendering errors, correct refusal/positive response handling. Consequently the incorrect positive responses create the wrong centre SVG and trail. This tests the actual page code, not real browser painting or browser-executed XSS. [60-case assertions](contract/current_callback_assertions.json), [22-case assertions](contract/supplementary_callback_assertions.json).
+- The fresh database oracle checked all **6,469 live centres**, all **22 relation/direction/type/role combinations**, with zero discrepancies; the contract lane separately exercised retired rows, malformed properties, values, cutting, safety, and demos. Details and scope are below.
+- No model was called. Diagnostic counterfactuals only replace helpers in process memory, restore them, and verify the restored baseline. No application code was changed. The conditional KOA/KhOpenApi before/after production-code requirement is therefore not triggered. All new scratch work is under `audit_evidence_claims/m30/`.

+## M30-B1 — unrecognized dye names bypass both ordinary-drug and ADC protection (P1)
+
+Exact primary: **`trastuzumab linked to eFluor 450`**. It returns **TRASTUZUMAB / CHEMBL1201585**, exactly the full bare-trastuzumab map (**13 graph trials**) and complete trial/sponsor QA evidence (**12 / 12 rows**). Eight further plain-antibody inputs and four ADC variants reproduce the same mechanism; every exact input is in the table below.
+
+At `src/query.py:246-265`, `_DYE_STEMS` and `_names_reagent` omit eFluor, VioBlue, Brilliant Ultraviolet/BUV, Brilliant Blue/BB, and Super Bright. `_item_joined` (`287-315`) recognizes `linked` only with a recognized reagent or `via`. For these descriptions, the relevant outside-name joining cue is false. No resolver BLOCKED component, `_resolver_blocked`, `_qualified`, isotope guard, `_marked`, whole-name fallback, public linker, or QA stage produces a refusal. `Engine.explore` at `src/app.py:88-95` therefore selects the ordinary accepted drug. [Current source excerpts](attacks/source_excerpts.txt).
+
+The ADC corroboration is **`trastuzumab emtansine linked to eFluor 450`**: **CHEMBL1743082**, **5 / 5 / 5** graph/trial-QA/sponsor-QA counts, with full object/array equality to bare emtansine. The new `_beyond_adc_words(rest)` is true, but the left-hand `_item_joined(rest)` at `src/query.py:624-626` is false, so the new condition never refuses. The whole-item joining helper may be true because it sees `emtansine`; that is not the outside-name expression actually used by the guard. Deruxtecan has the same failure (**CHEMBL4297844; 6 / 6 / 4**). This is a shared vocabulary/join-gate mechanism, not a second independent finding.
+
+The reagent premise is independently grounded: the manufacturer lists eFluor 450 as a dye with antibody conjugates. This establishes that the explicit linked-dye phrase describes a modified antibody, not any unique approved trastuzumab-dye product. [Thermo Fisher eFluor guide](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/life-science/cell-analysis/flow-cytometry/efluor-organic-dyes.html). Other named families have manufacturer support in [source register](attacks/external_sources.json).
+
+Controls distinguish the gap: **`trastuzumab emtansine conjugated to eFluor 450`** now refuses even though eFluor itself is unrecognized, proving the new descriptor guard works when joining is recognized. Bare ADCs and ordinary ADC descriptions remain accepted **as map inputs**; their question-wrapper regression is separately recorded in M30-S1. Known ATTO647N/Cy3B/CF488A/DY647P1/Pacific Blue/streptavidin cases refuse. Adding the exact missing dye identifiers only in memory repairs all **13** B1 cases and leaves B2 and the current control baseline unchanged. This is a causal diagnostic, not a completeness-tested dictionary repair. [Counterfactuals](attacks/counterfactual.json).
+
+## M30-B2 — explicit biotinylation and derivatization do not count as a modification (P1)
+
+Exact primary: **`biotinylated trastuzumab`**. It returns bare **TRASTUZUMAB / CHEMBL1201585**, the same complete map (**13 graph trials**) and QA arrays (**12 / 12 rows**). Five corroborations cover reversed wording, FITC derivatization, ATTO647N/Pacific Blue modification, and a further-modified named ADC. All six are direct and original-CLI HTTP leaks with no refusal at any actual stage.
+
+Unlike B1, reagent recognition is already true. +"""Root review of raw CLI responses, independent of attack-lane computed booleans."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT=OUT.parents[2]
+read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf8'))
+http=read(OUT/'independent_new_http.json')+read(OUT/'supplementary_http.json')
+by={(r['endpoint'],r['input']):r for r in http}
+def get(endpoint,text):
+    r=by[endpoint,text]
+    assert r['status']==200
+    return r['response']
+def refusals(qa):return [x for x in qa['entities'] if x['type']=='Refused']
+new=read(OUT.parent/'attacks/assertions.json')
+direct={r['text']:r for r in read(OUT.parent/'attacks/new_results.json')['cases']}
+rows=[]
+for declared in new['leaks']:
+    t,base=declared['text'],declared['control']
+    full=get('explore',t);canonical=get('explore',base);stage=direct[t]['current']
+    checks={'map_equals_bare':full==canonical,
+            'resolver_no_BLOCKED':all(not c['tier'].startswith('BLOCKED') for c in get('resolve',t)['components']),
+            'map_equals_direct':full==direct[t]['current']['map'],
+            'no_map_refusal':'refused' not in full,
+            'marked_was_exercised':bool(stage['marked_calls']),
+            'every_marked_none':all(x['result'] is None for x in stage['marked_calls']),
+            'resolver_blocked_empty':not stage['blocked'],
+            'qualified_false':stage['qualified'] is False,
+            'isotope_false':stage['item_has_isotope'] is False,
+            'whole_name_none':stage['whole_name'] is None,
+            'item_linker_no_refused':not any(x['type']=='Refused' for x in stage['item_linker']),
+            'public_linker_no_refused':not any(x['type']=='Refused' for x in stage['public_linker'])}
+    for kind,question in [('trial','Which trials evaluate {}?'),('sponsor','Who sponsors trials of {}?')]:
+        qa=get('ask',question.format(t));bare=get('ask',question.format(base))
+        checks[kind+'_full_evidence_equals_bare']=qa['evidence']==bare['evidence']
+        checks[kind+'_no_refused']=not refusals(qa)
+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)
+    rows.append({'text':t,'control':base,'checks':checks,'center':full['center']})

+# Independent relation-map review — round 30
+
+Reviewed **HEAD `8eb25556efae1825622f7cb1eb365370489ba39e`** on 2026-11-04 (Asia/Seoul). **CHANGES REQUIRED.** The **12 adjudicated leaks in m29/attacks/assertions.json are FIXED**, and **357 tests pass**. Two broader identity mechanisms remain: additional established dye families evade the reagent vocabulary, and explicit modification words such as `biotinylated` evade the joining/label guards. The new ADC descriptor check is downstream of the joining guard and cannot rescue these misses.
+
+The 19 new adjudicated inputs all pass complete bare-drug map and trial/sponsor QA evidence equality checks, both directly and through an independently launched original CLI server. Every actual refusal stage misses. These are inherited defects: the same inputs also leak when only `query.py` is replaced with HEAD^; this comparison is not a historical whole-deployment comparison. A separate **new QA regression** affects ordinary ADC-description controls (M30-S1 below). [Raw stage traces](attacks/new_results.json), [attack assertions](attacks/assertions.json), [independent root assertions](checks/independent_assertions.json).
+
+## Verification method
+
+Repair notes were hypotheses to test. Earlier reproduction scripts were copied and adapted only for output roots, ports, and current evidence loading; provenance and execution records are linked with the complete per-finding matrices below. M27 and M29 use their attack records because their reports were never completed. The original review baseline `bfcb83d4320877ffad47083c102ba1c38f691bba` resolves; the latest repair changes `src/query.py` and `tests/test_app.py`.
+
+- `python -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider`, with bytecode disabled and a scratch `--basetemp`: **357 passed in 38.40 seconds**, exit 0. [Output](checks/pytest.txt), [command/environment](checks/pytest_summary.json).
+- Root independently ran **`python -B -u src/app.py 9995`** in two sequential owned server lifecycles: **82 distinct inputs / 328 HTTP requests**, all HTTP 200. Responses cover all 77 attack-lane cases plus five extra controls. Page bytes equal the worktree, the database hash is unchanged, and port 9995 is closed. [First 60 inputs](checks/independent_new_http.json), [remaining 22 inputs](checks/supplementary_http.json), [first lifecycle](checks/independent_new_lifecycle.json), [second lifecycle](checks/supplementary_lifecycle.json), [reuse](checks/http_reuse_manifest.json), [supplement provenance](checks/supplementary_reuse_manifest.json). HTTP 200 alone was never counted as semantic success.
+- Actual `web/try.html` form callbacks were executed for all **82 responses** in a Node VM with controlled DOM/fetch: zero rendering errors, correct refusal/positive response handling. Consequently the incorrect positive responses create the wrong centre SVG and trail. This tests the actual page code, not real browser painting or browser-executed XSS. [60-case assertions](contract/current_callback_assertions.json), [22-case assertions](contract/supplementary_callback_assertions.json).
+- The fresh database oracle checked all **6,469 live centres**, all **22 relation/direction/type/role combinations**, with zero discrepancies; the contract lane separately exercised retired rows, malformed properties, values, cutting, safety, and demos. Details and scope are below.
+- No model was called. Diagnostic counterfactuals only replace helpers in process memory, restore them, and verify the restored baseline. No application code was changed. The conditional KOA/KhOpenApi before/after production-code requirement is therefore not triggered. All new scratch work is under `audit_evidence_claims/m30/`.

+## M30-B1 — unrecognized dye names bypass both ordinary-drug and ADC protection (P1)
+
+Exact primary: **`trastuzumab linked to eFluor 450`**. It returns **TRASTUZUMAB / CHEMBL1201585**, exactly the full bare-trastuzumab map (**13 graph trials**) and complete trial/sponsor QA evidence (**12 / 12 rows**). Eight further plain-antibody inputs and four ADC variants reproduce the same mechanism; every exact input is in the table below.
+
+At `src/query.py:246-265`, `_DYE_STEMS` and `_names_reagent` omit eFluor, VioBlue, Brilliant Ultraviolet/BUV, Brilliant Blue/BB, and Super Bright. `_item_joined` (`287-315`) recognizes `linked` only with a recognized reagent or `via`. For these descriptions, the relevant outside-name joining cue is false. No resolver BLOCKED component, `_resolver_blocked`, `_qualified`, isotope guard, `_marked`, whole-name fallback, public linker, or QA stage produces a refusal. `Engine.explore` at `src/app.py:88-95` therefore selects the ordinary accepted drug. [Current source excerpts](attacks/source_excerpts.txt).
+
+The ADC corroboration is **`trastuzumab emtansine linked to eFluor 450`**: **CHEMBL1743082**, **5 / 5 / 5** graph/trial-QA/sponsor-QA counts, with full object/array equality to bare emtansine. The new `_beyond_adc_words(rest)` is true, but the left-hand `_item_joined(rest)` at `src/query.py:624-626` is false, so the new condition never refuses. The whole-item joining helper may be true because it sees `emtansine`; that is not the outside-name expression actually used by the guard. Deruxtecan has the same failure (**CHEMBL4297844; 6 / 6 / 4**). This is a shared vocabulary/join-gate mechanism, not a second independent finding.
+
+The reagent premise is independently grounded: the manufacturer lists eFluor 450 as a dye with antibody conjugates. This establishes that the explicit linked-dye phrase describes a modified antibody, not any unique approved trastuzumab-dye product. [Thermo Fisher eFluor guide](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/life-science/cell-analysis/flow-cytometry/efluor-organic-dyes.html). Other named families have manufacturer support in [source register](attacks/external_sources.json).
+
+Controls distinguish the gap: **`trastuzumab emtansine conjugated to eFluor 450`** now refuses even though eFluor itself is unrecognized, proving the new descriptor guard works when joining is recognized. Bare ADCs and ordinary ADC descriptions remain accepted **as map inputs**; their question-wrapper regression is separately recorded in M30-S1. Known ATTO647N/Cy3B/CF488A/DY647P1/Pacific Blue/streptavidin cases refuse. Adding the exact missing dye identifiers only in memory repairs all **13** B1 cases and leaves B2 and the current control baseline unchanged. This is a causal diagnostic, not a completeness-tested dictionary repair. [Counterfactuals](attacks/counterfactual.json).
+
+## M30-B2 — explicit biotinylation and derivatization do not count as a modification (P1)
+
+Exact primary: **`biotinylated trastuzumab`**. It returns bare **TRASTUZUMAB / CHEMBL1201585**, the same complete map (**13 graph trials**) and QA arrays (**12 / 12 rows**). Five corroborations cover reversed wording, FITC derivatization, ATTO647N/Pacific Blue modification, and a further-modified named ADC. All six are direct and original-CLI HTTP leaks with no refusal at any actual stage.
+
+Unlike B1, reagent recognition is already true. The missing condition is the action: `_JOINED` at `src/query.py:225-226` omits `biotinylat`, `derivatiz`, and `functionaliz`; the label vocabulary at `src/query.py:191-199` also does not recognize biotinylated. `_item_joined(rest)` stays false and the ADC rule is again unreachable. The source distinction matters: broadening only the dye dictionary cannot repair the primary.
+
+The identity premise has an exact manufacturer example: CellMosaic separately describes biotin-labelled trastuzumab and the antibody before labelling. The query does not uniquely select that manufacturer's construct, but it affirmatively names a modification and cannot safely inherit all unmodified clinical evidence. [CellMosaic biotin-labelled trastuzumab](https://cellmosaic.com/aqt-biotin-reduced-thiol-labeled-trastuzumab-anti-her2-mab/), [Thermo Fisher biotinylation](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/life-science/protein-biology/protein-labeling-crosslinking/biotinylation.html).
+
+True-negative controls (`trastuzumab not biotinylated`, `... not derivatized with ATTO 647N`, `... not functionalized with Pacific Blue`) remain accepted. An in-memory addition of modification stems repairs all **six** B2 cases without repairing the 13 B1 cases or changing accepted controls. Restoration equals the baseline. [Literal before/replacement and outputs](attacks/counterfactual.json), [assertions](attacks/assertions.json).

+from pathlib import Path
+import json, posixpath, re
+OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+def read_json(p):return json.loads((OUT/p).read_text(encoding='utf8'))
+def embed(path):
+    text=(OUT/path).read_text(encoding='utf8')
+    base=posixpath.dirname(path)
+    def link(m):
+        t=m.group(1)
+        if re.match(r'^(?:[a-z]+:|/|#)',t):return m.group(0)
+        return ']('+posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(base,t))+')'
+    return re.sub(r'\]\(([^\s)]+)\)',link,text)

+"""Root review of raw CLI responses, independent of attack-lane computed booleans."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT=OUT.parents[2]
+read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf8'))
+http=read(OUT/'independent_new_http.json')+read(OUT/'supplementary_http.json')
+by={(r['endpoint'],r['input']):r for r in http}
+def get(endpoint,text):
+    r=by[endpoint,text]
+    assert r['status']==200
+    return r['response']
+def refusals(qa):return [x for x in qa['entities'] if x['type']=='Refused']
+new=read(OUT.parent/'attacks/assertions.json')
+direct={r['text']:r for r in read(OUT.parent/'attacks/new_results.json')['cases']}
+rows=[]
+for declared in new['leaks']:
+    t,base=declared['text'],declared['control']
+    full=get('explore',t);canonical=get('explore',base);stage=direct[t]['current']
+    checks={'map_equals_bare':full==canonical,
+            'resolver_no_BLOCKED':all(not c['tier'].startswith('BLOCKED') for c in get('resolve',t)['components']),
+            'map_equals_direct':full==direct[t]['current']['map'],
+            'no_map_refusal':'refused' not in full,
+            'marked_was_exercised':bool(stage['marked_calls']),
+            'every_marked_none':all(x['result'] is None for x in stage['marked_calls']),
+            'resolver_blocked_empty':not stage['blocked'],
+            'qualified_false':stage['qualified'] is False,
+            'isotope_false':stage['item_has_isotope'] is False,
+            'whole_name_none':stage['whole_name'] is None,
+            'item_linker_no_refused':not any(x['type']=='Refused' for x in stage['item_linker']),
+            'public_linker_no_refused':not any(x['type']=='Refused' for x in stage['public_linker'])}
+    for kind,question in [('trial','Which trials evaluate {}?'),('sponsor','Who sponsors trials of {}?')]:
+        qa=get('ask',question.format(t));bare=get('ask',question.format(base))
+        checks[kind+'_full_evidence_equals_bare']=qa['evidence']==bare['evidence']
+        checks[kind+'_no_refused']=not refusals(qa)
+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)
+    rows.append({'text':t,'control':base,'checks':checks,'center':full['center']})
+original=read(ROOT/'audit_evidence_claims/m29/attacks/assertions.json')
+repairs=[]
+for old in original['leaks']:
+    t=old['text'];m=get('explore',t)
+    checks={'refused':bool(m.get('refused')),'no_center':'center' not in m}
+    for kind,q in [('trial','Which trials evaluate {}?'),('sponsor','Who sponsors trials of {}?')]:
+        qa=get('ask',q.format(t));checks[kind+'_empty_evidence']=not qa['evidence'];checks[kind+'_refused']=bool(refusals(qa))
+    assert all(checks.values()),(t,checks)
+    repairs.append({'text':t,'status':'FIXED','checks':checks})
+regressions=[]
